test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In a circular race of 1 km, two persons X and Y start with the speed of 9 km/h and 18 km/h, respectively, at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time at the starting point when running in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of X = 9 km/h

Speed of Y = 18 km/h

Distance of the circular track = 1 km

**Formula used:**

Time taken to meet at the starting point = Distance / Relative Speed

Relative speed when running in the same direction = Speed of Y - Speed of X

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 18 - 9 = 9 km/h

Time taken to meet = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 1 / 9 hours

⇒ Time = (1 / 9) × 3600 seconds = 400 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
